sources.title: GitHub - ArgoHA/radiogalaxynet-dfine-vs-galdino
sources.snippet: The config is dfine/config.yaml: S model, COCO-detection init (auto-downloaded), 640² input, one keypoint with OKS sigma 0.107 (Gal-DINO's value), flips and 90° rotations. Photometric augmentations are off because the image channels encode radio intensity. The best checkpoint is picked on the val split.
